blocks.text: Part of our award-winning PSW Pot Collection, bulb pans from Arcadia Garden Products are made from a mix of recycled plastic, stone powder, and wood dust. This shallow container is ideal for growing a variety of plants that don’t require abundant space for deep roots, including various bulbs, succulents, herbs, bamboo, bonsai, microgreens, and more. Great for both indoor and outdoor use, the bottom of the bulb pan can be easily drilled using any standard drill bit. The winning combination of recycled ingredients in the PSW line makes this an attractive, lightweight product that is also weather resistant and easy to clean. The bulb pan is available in a variety of colors and sizes and features a stylish, raised floral embellishment on one side. A thoughtful gift for those who enjoy plants and planting, PSW Pots have exceptional strength and eye-catching visual appeal. And because it coordinates with other PSW containers, you can choose from a variety of additional matching pots and saucers to make your garden collection complete.

items.label: Made with Recycled Materials
items.value: A blend of recycled plastic, stone powder, and wood dust, PSW Pots are eye-catching and long-lasting for mindful gardening.

items.label: Drillable
items.value: These pots do NOT include holes for drainage, but they can easily be added using any standard drill bit without damaging the integrity of the pot.

items.label: Size
items.value: The 12-inch planter measures 11.8” round and 5” tall, with an opening diameter of 11”.

items.label: For Plants with Shallow Roots
items.value: This pot is ideal for plants that don’t have deep roots, including bulbs, succulents, herbs, bamboo, bonsai, microgreens, and more.

items.label: Multiple Uses
items.value: Crafters, artists, and hobbyists can get creative using these planters for fairy gardens, homemade fountains, art pieces, and more.

items.label: Lightweight & Durable
items.value: PSW Pots are durable, lightweight, and resistant to weather conditions and UV rays for extended outdoor use.

items.label: One-of-a-Kind
items.value: Due to the blending of recycled materials, every PSW pot is unique with slight variations that infer an artisan’s touch.
